body.reason: 'SDH' is an abbreviation or symbol, not an enzyme name, and Caterva does not resolve one by itself; 2 enzymes go by it

candidates.name: succinate dehydrogenase
candidates.why: SDH is a common abbreviation for succinate dehydrogenase and sorbitol (L-iditol) dehydrogenase; it is also used for other enzymes, so the choice is yours
candidates.reaction: a quinone + succinate = fumarate + a quinol.
candidates.class_path: Oxidoreductases > acting on the CH-CH group of donors > with a quinone or related compound as acceptor
